name: ListPolicyAttachments

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group or the ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the resource group belongs. If you do not configure this parameter, the system lists all policy attachment records within the current account
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID或资源组所属的阿里云账号ID。取值为空表示列出当前账号下的所有授权记录
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the permission policy. If you do not configure this parameter, all types of policies are returned. Valid values:

Custom
System
parameters.help_zh:
权限策略类型。取值为空表示列出所有类型的权限策略。

Custom：自定义策略。
System：系统策略
parameters.name: policy_type

parameters.help_en:
The name of the permission policy.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and hyphen (-)
parameters.help_zh:
权限策略名称。

长度为1~128个字符，可包含英文字母、数字和短横线（-）
parameters.name: policy_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the object to which you want to attach the permission policy. If you do not configure this parameter, the system lists all types of objects. Valid values:

IMSUser: RAM user
IMSGroup: RAM user group
ServiceRole: RAM role
parameters.help_zh:
被授权对象类型。取值为空表示列出所有类型的被授权对象。

IMSUser：RAM用户。
IMSGroup：RAM用户组。
ServiceRole：RAM角色
parameters.name: principal_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the object to which you want to attach the permission policy
parameters.name: principal_name

parameters.help_en:
The page number.

Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1

页码。

起始值：1。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页时每页显示的数据行数。

取值范围：1~100。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The language in which you want to return the description of the system policy. Valid values:

en: English
zh-CN: Chinese
ja: Japanese

语言类型。系统权限策略的描述将以此语言返回。
